reviews.x: Helps me make the wing eyeliner look since I'm having a hard time figuring it out. Super easy instructions. Works great for hooded eyes like mine.

All in all, these work really well. I took off a star because there's a tiny manufacturing defect. The lids pull off instead of screw off, which is actually great, but because of the momentum left over from using energy to pop off the tops, the liquid inside splatters everywhere when you open them. That wouldn't even really be an issue, BUT because the liquid is smudge-proof...it is very difficult to get the spilled drops off your counter or vanity, etc. So, just maybe remember to open these ove

reviews.t: Game Changer for Makeup Challenged Folks
reviews.x: As a makeup challenged lady I always admired a good winged eyeliner look but struggled to replicate it myself. Well let me tell you this eyeliner is a game changer! The wing stamps look so good and are so easy to apply. Then adding the eye liner to the rest of your eye is a piece of cake with it’s super smooth application. It dries quickly, lasts all day, and haven’t had any issues with smudging at all. This one product may just turn me into a regular makeup wearer! I love this and will be order

I was really excited about this product. Arrived broken, when you open it the stamp is stuck inside the cover. Then when you force it out and stick it back together as it should be, it's just very unstable. Probably because it's broken. It keeps falling apart. I decided I would just use the felt pen side and not the stamp because it's nice and dark, goes on smooth. However that side also just broke apart. It actually made a huge mess. I threw them in the trash. Waste of money.

reviews.t: Quick Application, but exploded on me the first time I opened it.
reviews.x: First time opening the packaging the R wing side lid was a little stuck, I pulled a little harder and got ink ALL OVER ME and my desk where I apply makeup. After cleaning it off and trying it it still worked. Did not have the same issue with the L side. The wing stamp part is nice but the pen was rough on my eyelid and didn't apply well, ended up using my original eye liner to fill in fro the wing. Will probably return it.

No lo recomiendo a nadie es tirar tu dinero a la basura.

Additionally,  this product does not smudge and it looks as amazing at dinner as it did leaving for work!! Lastly, to top it off, the sellers are amazing....great communication and speed!! Will definitely buy  here again!!

Well one worked the other didnt you get 2 pens/ stamps one side is a stamp for your right the other for your left i got one that worked and the other didnt so its a flop for me only good part is i can still use the pin part for eyeliner as long as it doesnt dry out the do offer a ticket for a warranty pretty much for a replacement but hell i bought it for it to work so i just wont be getting another

I was able to get a great eyeline right away even though the instructions say the product requires practice. I'm terrible at using liquid liner so that was great! Very dramatic though. Would love if the stamps were a little bit smaller. The other problem I have with them is that when I open and close the pen side it leaks a little. But overall I'm very pleased with this purchase!

Loved this eye liner. Super easy application and deep black shade. It gives the perfect shape without fail!  I chose the smallest option, thinking I wouldn't want anything overly dramatic... but I find that I need to apply it out further than is recommended to get the look I'm going for. When I need a refill I will chose one of the bigger options. Overall: I love it!

Love the dark black pigment and ease of use of the liner.  There is 1 tube of eyeliner for each eye & the only reason I didn't give this product 5 stars is because the writing on the tubes is sooo small it is hard to tell if  "L" or "R".  Other than that the linter gives a nice cat eye.  I purchased the shortest cat eye liner & would consider purchasing it again.

reviews.t: Love this product! Will definitely reorder.
reviews.x: I don’t usually leave reviews unless I’m overly impressed with a product. I don’t do average reviews. I bought this product for my 16 y/o who is just now getting into make-up. This product worked beautifully. It was easy for her to use, looked great, and held up. Great product that was delivered quickly. Will definitely order again.

Love this stamp! It has saved my liner game! I went from awkward uneaven shaped wings to perfect wings using this product! It has a lot of options as well for shape and angle so if you're worried about variety you have options. I also love the liner end. Its so smooth and the perfect shade. Lasts all day!

I'm super happy with the stamps, it comes 2 (one for each eye left/right) and each has the eyeliner to fill. Instructions are really easy. Perfect for somebody like me who doesn't know how to apply make up at all! I simple love it. Thanks Lucy & James for creating such a great product. Wish you luck!

This product is my favorite. i was never good at doing winged liner but with this stamp liner it honestly makes it super freaking easy!! i love that on one side its the stamp and the other side is the felt pen part to fix anything you need !! and thank you to the seller for everything!!

This product gives you a perfect winged tip for your top eyebrow. I've never been able to really  create the look by manually drawing the winged tip but using this product has made it really easy and it doesn't take much time at all. I have recommended this product to my friends.

reviews.t: Left pen doesnt work only right
reviews.x: The product is great but i only have one working side. Now at first i thought it was just the fact it was sitting for too long but i cant get any liner out of the left pen. So i can get perfect wings for the right but not the left which defeats the purpose of this product.

So far I love this eyeliner. I love stamp eyeliners because they are super easy to make my wings with your eyeliner. Just stamp, line and go! This one has stayed put all day so far and I  highly recommend you get it to make your eyeliner wings. You want be disappointed!

I "just" received my order and the left side pen is dried up. I'm going to contact the seller and see if I can get a replacement. But, this does cause me to wonder how long the right pen will last. Other than that, the right side was very easy to use. and looks good.

Worked great! I didn't have high expectations when ordering, but this product was amazing. I get a perfect wing everytime. There's no smudging...it glides on perfectly...washes off with soap and water! Great product for people like me who are exploring makeup trends!

reviews.t: Be careful of messes, but totally worth it!
reviews.x: Was great until one day when I pulled on the cap and the whole thing practically exploded and the black got everywhere. Would use again even with that mess! This is the easiest way I’ve ever gotten winged eyeliner that didn’t look like a deranged 13 year old did it.

I have never been able to wing my eyeliner.  Just never got the hang of it, plus my hands shake too much.  I ordered this and for the first time I have wings!  Takes a little practice, but you get it down quick.  Thank you for helping me achieve the look I love!

I have hooded eyes and have a hard time finding an eyeliner that doesn’t rub off into my kids until I found this. Isn’t irritating and once it dries it stays relatively well all day long. The cat eye is also super easy to master with this. Love this product.

I originally bought this and sent it to my daughter who is in college. She is a wing tip gal. I went to visit her and used it and was so surprised. She said be careful once its on ITS ON! I used the stamp and lined and was UBER impressed. I  bought one too.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the wing stamps easy to use and helpful for achieving a winged eyeliner look, especially for makeup beginners.
Several reviewers report the product splattering or leaking ink when opening the lids.
Some reviewers praise the dark black pigment and long-lasting, non-smudging wear.
A few reviewers received defective or broken units, including one side not working or the stamp stuck in the cap.
Some reviewers note the stamps are too large or dramatic and would prefer smaller options.
